scripts.node:start: hardhat node > hardhat_node.log 2>&1 & echo $! > .hardhat-node.pid; echo "Local node starting at http://127.0.0.1:8545 (PID $(cat .hardhat-node.pid), log in hardhat_node.log)"
scripts.node:stop: if [ -f .hardhat-node.pid ] && kill $(cat .hardhat-node.pid) 2>/dev/null; then rm -f .hardhat-node.pid; echo "Local node stopped"; else rm -f .hardhat-node.pid; echo "No local node was running"; fi
